extracted.intended_audience: people seeking to obtain or interpret prophetic dreams (oniromancy practitioners or lay readers interested in dream-divination)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on how to prepare for, obtain, and interpret prophetic dreams (oniromancy), including bodily and mental preparation, symbols (e.g., horns), signs of true vs. false dreams, and the need for skilled interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a skilled interpreter (oniropolist)
rubrics_metrics.description: For the better reading, explaining, and unfolding of somniatory vaticinations and predictions it is requisite that a dexterous, learned, skilful, wise, industrious, expert, rational, and peremptory expounder or interpreter be pitched upon, such a one as by the Greeks is called onirocrit, or oniropolist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dreams are seldom able to report things in full sincerity because of the imperfection and frailty of the corporeal senses; therefore a knowledgeable interpreter is needed to unfold the mystical signs and to correct for sensory distortion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear, calm mental state (denude the mind of passions)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must denude your mind of every human passion or affection, such as are love and hatred, fear and hope, for the part in him which is the most divine, to wit, the Nous, or Mens, must be calm, peaceable, untroubled, quiet, still, hushed, and not embusied or distracted with foreign, soul-disturbing perturbations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mental tranquility is necessary because the divine part of the soul must be calm to receive and report heavenly insights. Anti-pattern: going to sleep emotionally agitated will corrupt or obscure any prophetic content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sleep soundly (quality of sleep matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fail not therefore to-morrow ... to bend your spirits wholly to the task of sleeping sound, and thereto apply yourself. In dreaming ... the soul doth oftentimes foresee what is to come.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deep, uninterrupted sleep allows the soul to 'review its native country' (the heavens) and bring back clearer visions. Interrupted or dozy sleep results in incoherent nonsense and unreliable dreams (Panurge's complaint).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid extreme fasting or extreme feasting (moderation in diet)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mediocrity at all times is commendable ... You may take a little supper, but thereat must you not eat of a hare, nor of any other flesh. ... I am truly right apt to believe that a man whose stomach is replete with various cheer, and in a manner surfeited with drinking, is hardly able to conceive aright of spiritual things; yet am not I of the opinion of those who, after long and pertinacious fastings, think by such means to enter more profoundly into the speculation of celestial mysteries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pantagruel recommends a modest supper rather than abstaining entirely or gorging; both satiety and prolonged fasting impair the spirits. Example/anti-patterns: Amphiaraus' strict prescription (24 hours no victuals, 3 days no wine) is cited but rejected as too severe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid certain foods before sleeping (avoid windy/heavy victuals)
rubrics_metrics.description: You are likewise to abstain from beans, from the preak, by some called the polyp, as also from coleworts, cabbage, and all other such like windy victuals, which may endanger the troubling of your brains and the dimming or casting a kind of mist over your animal spirits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended light supper: Eusebian and Bergamot pears, one short-shank pippin apple, small plums of Tours, a few cherries; drink pure fountain water. Anti-pattern: heavy meats, beans, cabbage or alcohol that produce vapours and confuse the fancy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not rely on talismans or superstitious amulets
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no need at all of that, quoth Pantagruel; for, besides that it is a thing very superstitious, the cheat thereof hath been at large discovered unto us ... of the left shoulder of a crocodile, as also of a chameleon ... the stone of the Bactrians ... the Ammonian horn ... they over and above assuredly affirming that the dreams of those who carry it about them are no less veritable and infallible than the truth of the divine oracles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid superstitious practices (laurel under the pillow, exotic charms) — these are labeled cheats and exposed in classical writings. Rely instead on proper mental/physical preparation and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize external noises and distractions
rubrics_metrics.description: It is a most difficult thing for the spirits to be in a good plight, serene and lively, when there is nothing in the body but a kind of voidness and inanity; seeing the philosophers with the physicians jointly affirm ... The philosopher who ... was surrounded and environed about so with the barking of curs, bawling of mastiffs, bleating of sheep ... was much more troubled than if he had been in the middle of the crowd.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External commotion and sensory disturbance (noises, animals, general bustle) hinder contemplative faculties and the soul's access to prophetic impressions. Create a quiet environment to favor clear dreams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpret dream imagery contextually (symbols are not always literal)
rubrics_metrics.description: The horns that my wife did make me are horns of abundance, planted and grafted in my head for the increase and shooting up of all good things ... As for the rest, I will be no less joyful ... Who will not believe this ... Speak somewhat more correctly, lest she, being offended, furnish you with a pair of horns ... The goodly Bacchus also carries horns ... Are they all cuckolds?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Symbols (e.g., horns) can signify different things depending on context and cultural/metaphorical usage: they may indicate cuckoldry or abundance. Do not interpret images mechanically; consider broader mythological and poetic senses and compare with authoritative interpreters (Artemidorus, Virgilian lots).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use classical comparative rules (Virgilian lots / Artemidorus)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hereby may you perceive your dreams to be in every jot conform and agreeable to the Virgilian lots. This point is clearly and manifestly explained and expounded by Artemidorus just as I have related it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare a dream's motifs with established traditional authorities (Virgilian lots, Artemidorus) when assigning meaning. Established correspondences can validate interpretations, but must be applied judiciously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign: dreams that end with a sudden start predict evil or imminent mishap
rubrics_metrics.description: Know for a certain truth, that every sleep that endeth with a starting, and leaves the person irksome, grieved, and fretting, doth either signify a present evil, or otherwise presageth and portendeth a future imminent mishap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples are given (Hecuba, Eurydice, Aeneas) where sudden-awakening dreams preceded disasters (death, the fall of Troy, storm at sea). Use the 'ending with a start' as a diagnostic sign of negative portent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish divine vs infernal apparitions by emotional arc
rubrics_metrics.description: The favourable and comforting angel useth in his appearing unto man at first to terrify and hugely affright him, but in the end he bringeth consolation, leaveth the person ... joyful, well-pleased, fully content, and satisfied; on the other side, the angel of perdition ... at his appearance unto any person in the beginning cheereth up the heart of his beholder, but at last forsakes him, and leaves him troubled, angry, and perplexed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge the source of an apparition by whether it leaves the dreamer ultimately comforted (divine) or ultimately troubled (infernal). The initial affective tone alone is insufficient; the final emotional state matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bodily concoction/digestion state influences clairvoyance
rubrics_metrics.description: When our body is at rest, that the concoction is everywhere accomplished, and that, till it awake, it lacks for nothing, our soul delighteth to disport itself ... Hence it is requisite ... the animal spirits ... spring from, and have their constant practice in and through the arterial blood, refined and purified to the life within the admirable net ... lieth under the ventricles and tunnels of the brain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proper digestion/concoction and a balanced bodily state are prerequisites for clear dreams; bodily imbalances (overfeeding, extreme hunger, windy foods) disturb the 'animal spirits' and confuse dream-impression. Time sleep so that digestion is suitable for clear reception.
